correctness.rationale: For char 0 or p>n+1, each derivation of k[t]/t^(n+1) has unique basis e_i=t^(i+1)d/dt and [e_i,e_j]=(j-i)e_(i+j) for i+j<n. For nonzero leading e_i coefficient with i<ceil(n/2), ad_f has rank n-i-1: non-i lower columns have distinct nonzero leading pivots, the omitted i column is dependent via [f,f]=0, and all degree>=n-i columns vanish. Hence C(f)=kf+F_(n-i), forcing rank-one quotient condition for all commuting tuples. Conversely every such quotient rank-one tuple commutes since F_(n-i) is abelian and centralizes F_i. Irreducible affine determinantal factors are proved geometrically integral and pairwise noncontained; a disjoint leading-degree enumeration yields the finite-field count. Python finite tests n=2,3 q=5 and adjoint rank distributions independently passed, and these do not replace infinite proof. Original bracket scheme reducedness explicitly left unproved.

value.rationale: Derivations of truncated one-variable local rings form a classical family of filtered Lie algebras. Classifying every irreducible component of the reduced ordered commuting s-tuple variety for all s simultaneously gives a complete moduli-level and finite-field arithmetic description, with a genuine arity-induced transition to nonequidimensionality. The affine rank-one determinantal factors and exact point count are natural geometric and arithmetic invariants not just numerical special cases.
